reason: Full independent review confirmed the trusted 459-line raw SHA-256 and canonical URL, candidate.md byte equality with receipt.source_page, semantic equality of suggestions.json with receipt.suggestions, five byte-exact excerpts at their stated line ranges, the path-qualified raw backlink, absent canonical target, and deterministic wiki validation.
